reuse.why: Routes every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, through the existing isMonthFillCategory predicate and getAverageBudgetAmount sign helper, and reuses extractTagsFromText from shared/tags for the #fixed tag.

duplication.why: The exclusion rules live in one predicate; the only repetition is the extra has_template/group_note projection and notes join added to the three category queries (getBudgetData, setZero, getSpendingFillCategories).

placement.why: Rules stay in the predicate in server/budget/actions.ts, the handler is registered in server/budget/app.ts beside its siblings.

scope.why: Only month-wide actions, their registration and tests.

maintainability.why: One predicate, one options type (MonthActionOptions) and one category-loading helper make the rule easy to own; the projection repeated in three SQL strings and the loose goal_def IS NOT NULL check are the remaining rough edges.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through isMonthFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated column list is plain repetition of a projection, not reshaped logic.

abstraction_drift.where: getSpendingFillCategories (renamed from getAverageFillCategories) gains an includeHiddenCategories parameter that every action passes through; isMonthFillCategory's option is renamed and its template/#fixed conditions apply uniformly, with no per-action branches.
